== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The remaster excludes the indicated Reflections III Boba Fett in place of the destiny restriction. Its protection from exclusion or loss ends at the damage segment. Both retain the Slave I drawn-destiny bonus and the optional Effect loss for the weapon destiny bonus.
